versions.changelog: Add AUDIT mode: review an existing site (existing pages or URL) into a gap report (Present-OK/Inadequate/Missing/Mismatch) + remediation gate, alongside the existing build mode.

Initial release: fact-driven compliance classifier, modular document generator, and evidence-based release gate. Covers GDPR/UK/PECR/CCPA/PIPEDA/CASL/Australia + Apple/Google/Shopify platform rules across 12 business types.
